question: In January 2025, Chief Minister Conrad K Sangma inaugurated the 6th Meghalaya Games at which venue in Jowai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wahiajer Multi Sports Complex Stadium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **6th edition** of the **Meghalaya Games** was officially inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Meghalaya, **Conrad K Sangma**, in **January 2025**.
 
• The prestigious multi-sporting event was hosted at the **Wahiajer Multi Sports Complex Stadium**, which is located in **Jowai** within the **West Jaintia Hills** district.
 
• This event marks a significant step in the state government's policy to decentralize sports and host major tournaments in different districts to promote local talent and improve **sports infrastructure**.
 
• The **6th Meghalaya Games** involved the participation of approximately **3,000 athletes** representing all the districts of the state, competing in various disciplines such as **Athletics**, **Archery**, **Football**, and **Boxing**.
 
• The inauguration ceremony was attended by several dignitaries, including the Sports and Youth Affairs Minister, highlighting the state's commitment to the **"Sports Youth Policy"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Meghalaya State Olympic Association (MSOA):** 
 
 
• The **MSOA**, in collaboration with the **Department of Sports and Youth Affairs**, is the primary body responsible for organizing the **Meghalaya Games**.
 
• The association aims to prepare state athletes for national-level competitions, including the **National Games of India**.
 
 
 
• **Previous Editions:** 
 
 
• The **5th edition** of the Meghalaya Games was held in **January 2024** in **Tura**, West Garo Hills, and was inaugurated by the **President of India**, **Droupadi Murmu**.
 
• Before **2022**, the games were largely centered in the state capital, **Shillong**, but have since moved to different regions like **Garo Hills** and **Jaintia Hills** to ensure inclusive growth.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure Development:** 
 
 
• The **Wahiajer Multi Sports Complex** is a state-of-the-art facility featuring modern amenities for indoor and outdoor sports, funded as part of the state’s massive investment in **sports facilities** totaling over **Rs. 500 crore** in recent years.
 
• The government is focusing on creating **synthetic tracks** and **astroturf football grounds** across various blocks in Meghalaya.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **STAR Talent Identification Program:** 
 
 
• During the games, the government utilizes the **STAR program** to scientifically test and identify young athletes with high potential for elite training.
 
• Meghalaya has successfully tested over **15,000 children** under this initiative to build a robust **sporting ecosystem**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Venue:** 
 
 
• The choice of **Wahiajer** in **Jowai** emphasizes the government's effort to reach the rural youth and provide them with a platform similar to that available in urban centers.
 
• The **Meghalaya Games** serves as a selection trial for athletes to represent the state in the **North East Games** and other national forums.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Integration:** 
 
 
• The games are not just about sports but also showcase the rich **cultural heritage** of the **Khasi**, **Garo**, and **Jaintia** communities through various cultural performances during the opening and closing ceremonies.
